title: Evaluation of a GDNF-eluting nanofibrous PCL conduit in a mouse model of peripheral nerve injury
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23177-23189
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03291E, Paper

Louis D. V. Johnson, Holly N. Gregory, James B. Phillips, Sara Memarpour Hobbi, Fiona M. Boissonade, Frederik Claeyssens
An electrospun nerve guidance conduit comprised of aligned, growth factor-loaded nanofibres and a fibrin hydrogel promotes peripheral nerve regeneration, demonstrating comparable axonal growth to the nerve graft in a severe injury model.
